crossRefs.note: Now the king of Syria had commanded the thirty-two captains of his chariots, saying, “Don’t fight with small nor great…
Surely the wrath of man praises you. The survivors of your wrath are restrained.

parallels.note: Now the king of Syria had commanded the captains of his chariots, saying, “Don’t fight with small nor great, except…
When the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, they said, “It is the king of Israel!” Therefore they turned around…
When the captains of the chariots saw that it was not the king of Israel, they turned back from pursuing him.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: When the captains of the chariots saw that it was not the king of Israel, they turned back from pursuing him.
translations.bsb: And when the chariot commanders saw that he was not the king of Israel, they turned back from pursuing him.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots perceived that it was not the king of Israel, that they turned back from pursuing him.
